an3.61:1.1: 62 tīṇīmāni bhikkhave titthāyatanāni yāni paṇḍitehi samanuyuñjiyamānāni samanuggāhiyamānāni samanubhāsiyamānāni parampi gantvā akiriyāya saṇṭhahanti
an3.61:1.3: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
an3.61:1.4: yaṃkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ pubbe katahetūti
an3.61:1.5: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
an3.61:1.6: yaṃkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ issaranimmānahetūti
an3.61:1.7: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
an3.61:1.8: yaṃkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ ahetuappaccayāti.
an3.61:2.1: tatra bhikkhave ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
an3.61:2.2: yaṃkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ pubbe katahetūti tyāhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi
an3.61:2.3: saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
an3.61:2.4: yaṃkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ pubbe katahetūti.
an3.61:2.5: te ce me evaṃ puṭṭhā āmāti paṭijānanti
an3.61:2.7: tenahāyasmanto pāṇātipātino bhavissanti pubbe katahetu adinnādāyino bhavissanti pubbe katahetu abrahmacārino bhavissanti pubbe katahetu musāvādino bhavissanti pubbe katahetu pisuṇavācā bhavissanti pubbe katahetu pharusavācā bhavissanti pubbe katahetu samphappalāpino bhavissanti pubbe katahetu abhijjhāluno bhavissanti pubbe katahetu byāpannacittā bhavissanti pubbe katahetu micchādiṭṭhikā bhavissanti pubbe katahetu.
an3.61:3.1: pubbe kataṃ kho pana bhikkhave sārato paccāgacchataṃ na hoti chando vā vāyāmo vā idaṃ vā karaṇīyaṃ idaṃ vā akaraṇīyanti
an3.61:3.2: iti karaṇīyākaraṇīye kho pana saccato thetato anupalabbhiyamāne muṭṭhassatīnaṃ anārakkhānaṃ viharataṃ na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo
an3.61:3.3: ayaṃ kho me bhikkhave tesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu evaṃvādīsu evaṃdiṭṭhīsu paṭhamo sahadhammiko niggaho hoti.
an3.61:4.1: tatra bhikkhave ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
an3.61:4.2: yaṃkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ issaranimmānahetūti tyāhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadāmi
an3.61:4.3: saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
an3.61:4.4: yaṃkiñcāyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā sabbantaṃ issaranimmānahetūti.
an3.61:4.5: te ce me evaṃ puṭṭhā āmāti paṭijānanti
an3.61:4.7: tenahāyasmanto pāṇātipātino bhavissanti issaranimmānahetu …pe… micchādiṭṭhikā bhavissanti issaranimmānahetu.
an3.61:5.1: issaranimmānānaṃ kho pana bhikkhave sārato paccāgacchataṃ na hoti chando vā vāyāmo vā idaṃ vā karaṇīyaṃ idaṃ vā akaraṇīyanti
an3.61:5.2: iti karaṇīyākaraṇīye kho pana saccato thetato anupalabbhiyamāne muṭṭhassatīnaṃ anārakkhānaṃ viharataṃ na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo
an3.61:5.3: ayaṃ kho me bhikkhave tesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu evaṃvādīsu evaṃdiṭṭhīsu dutiyo sahadhammiko niggaho hoti.

an3.61:6.3: saccaṃ kira tumhe āyasmanto evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino

an3.61:6.5: te ce me evaṃ puṭṭhā āmāti paṭijānanti
an3.61:6.7: tenahāyasmanto pāṇātipātino bhavissanti ahetuappaccayā …pe… micchādiṭṭhikā bhavissanti ahetuappaccayā.
an3.61:7.1: ahetu kho pana bhikkhave sārato paccāgacchataṃ na hoti chando vā vāyāmo vā idaṃ vā karaṇīyaṃ idaṃ vā akaraṇīyanti

an3.61:8.1: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi titthāyatanāni yāni paṇḍitehi samanuyuñjiyamānāni samanuggāhiyamānāni samanubhāsiyamānāni parampi gantvā akiriyāya saṇṭhahanti.
an3.61:9.1: ayaṃ kho pana bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi
an3.61:9.2: katamo ca bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi
an3.61:9.3: imā cha dhātuyoti bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
an3.61:9.4: imāni cha phassāyatanānīti bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
an3.61:9.5: ime aṭṭhārasa manopavicārāti bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
an3.61:9.6: imāni cattāri ariyasaccānīti bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhi.
an3.61:10.1: imā cha dhātuyoti bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhīti
an3.61:10.5: paṭhavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu ākāsadhātu viññāṇadhātu
an3.61:10.6: imā cha dhātuyoti bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhīti
an3.61:10.7: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

an3.61:11.7: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

an3.61:13.1: imāni cattāri ariyasaccānīti bhikkhave mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṅkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikkuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhīti
